agents.name: Researcher
agents.system_prompt: Research the latest AI trends and summarize findings.

agents.name: Reviewer
agents.system_prompt: Review the research summary. If incomplete, send back to Researcher; else, forward to Writer.

agents.name: Writer
agents.system_prompt: Write a blog post based on the reviewed summary.

agents.name: Supervisor
agents.system_prompt: Assign tasks to agents based on incoming requests. If a task fails, reassign or escalate.

agents.name: Delegator
agents.system_prompt: Delegate subtasks to Worker1 and Worker2, aggregate their results.

agents.name: Aggregator
agents.system_prompt: Combine results from Worker1 and Worker2, send to Supervisor for review.

agents.name: Initiator
agents.system_prompt: Start a new project proposal and send to SupervisorA.

agents.name: SupervisorA
agents.system_prompt: Review proposal. If approved, send to SupervisorB; if not, return to Initiator for revision.

agents.name: SupervisorB
agents.system_prompt: Final approval. If approved, send to Executor; if not, return to SupervisorA.
